referencePixelCoverage: All 98 listed 250 m squares. The same independently retrieved official supplemental Parliament/Cathedral exports used for the historical review fill the private-mosaic boundary.
reviewStatus: Corrected source capture fully inspected with explicit architectural and source-data gaps; no exact visual-parity acceptance.
limitations: North-up square perspective game cameras and off-nadir reference imagery displace elevated roofs differently. Reference acquisition dates remain unknown; the comparison is not a pixel registration score.

Literal OSM heights, minima, footprints and courtyard rings stay authoritative over an apparent imagery conflict. Untagged heights, roof rises, facade materials, cornices and detailed roof forms remain estimates or native approximations.

Historic blocks and the Unirea roof retain simplified roof detail; broad source mass and courtyard coverage do not establish exact architectural parity. Canopy crown form and density still differ visibly from the aerial imagery.

The dataset retains 15758 mapped/measured tree entries. This capture places 15723; 35 geometric exclusions remain explicit: 31 road checks, three mapped centres inside source buildings, one measured centre inside mapped water. No tree cap is reached.

Only 23 independently reviewed non-crown detections were removed from the raw Unirii survey. Raw candidate evidence and all other source trees remain preserved; this is not an individual validation of every automated crown candidate.
Five contradictory literal source height/minimum profiles remain preserved and rejected by native roof compilation; four dependent roof caches use complete-source fallback.
All optional distant squares lie outside the required 600 m ring and retain coarse contextual treatment. The Cathedral reference shows an older construction state.

These world-only top-down captures disable moving traffic and mirrors. Full public-road Street View, public movement, grade/bridge clearance, drone-controller coverage and evolving traffic/mirror budgets remain separate gates.

reviewedSheetGroups.finding: Core and scenery source blocks, roads, courtyard voids and canopy reviewed throughout; simplified roofs, facade details and canopy shape remain visible.
Boundary and optional context retained separately; source exterior geometry and Cathedral construction-date mismatch remain explicit.
